vo.previous_text: Each station's Avg. VWC comes from a TurfRad moisture scan: the mean volumetric water content measured across the station, with the date it was captured beside the station name.
vo.next_text: Target VWC is the moisture you want that station to hold. It is yours to set, station by station, between 0 and 50 percent.

vo.text: Target VWC is the moisture you want that station to hold. It is yours to set, station by station, between 0 and 50 percent.

vo.next_text: The gap between measured and target is what the calculation works on. Target VWC is an editable input, not a reading.

vo.text: The gap between measured and target is what the calculation works on. Target VWC is an editable input, not a reading.
vo.previous_text: Target VWC is the moisture you want that station to hold. It is yours to set, station by station, between 0 and 50 percent.
vo.next_text: The difference between target and measured moisture becomes an amount of water, today's ET is added, the daily maximum caps it, and the result is divided by the Lynx reference amount to give a percentage.
